diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the implicit dependency created by the provisioner's ENDPOINT reference to the cluster endpoint.
